collection_flag: Explicit undergraduate/professional suitability in scholarship bibliography and international congress performance.
findings: SAMRO archive confirms 2005 and reports performance directions are in English and intended as guidance.
University of Pretoria annotated bibliography gives alto saxophone and piano, nine minutes, copyright Loveday 2005, SAMRO call A06364.
Bibliography documents 2008 SAMRO scholarship intermediate-round prescribed repertoire and 16 April 2005 premiere at Wits Atrium by Ceri Moelwyn-Hughes and Gregory Mollenz.
Gerber's bibliography explicitly describes professional performance and undergraduate relevance, with changing 4/4, 5/4, 3/4 and 2/4 meters. This is published analysis, not personal score inspection.
Matthew Lombard and Casey Dierlam programmed it at World Saxophone Congress Zagreb, 14 July 2018.
SAMRO currently shows the score being processed with an inquiry form; a downloadable score is not yet available there.

evidence.claim: 9 minutes, A06364, premiere, scholarship use and analysis
evidence.source_name: Karlien Gerber, University of Pretoria bibliography

gaps: SAMRO download currently unavailable; inquiry route only.
